endorsements.name: Joshua Dalman
endorsements.label: Commercial Mobile Spyware - Detecting the Undetectable
endorsements.description: Research shows commercial spyware is becoming common place. These programs turn smartphones into effective spy tools and pose a threat to both smartphone users privacy and to corporate enterprises. Furthermore, the tools are sold and marketed as being completely undetectable to the users. We put that claim to the test.
